name: upi-fraud-detector-mern
description: UPI Fraud Pattern Detector - MERN app (MongoDB, Express, React, Node) with a Python detection microservice

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && pip install -r detection-service/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n detect,api,web -c yellow,green,cyan "npm run dev:detection" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.test: npm run test:detection && npm run test:server
scripts.test:detection: cd detection-service && python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
